positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineer in the Planner Validation & Verification team. Worked with the Emergency Response group,
implementing ad hoc metrics in C++ to evaluate behaviors around emergency vehicles and accident
zones, built datasets, and maintained weekly VnV process. Scoped metrics with perception and planner
engineers, and helped them understand the signal they provided, and got feedback from them.
Designed and implemented Python backend API to consume, analyze, and compare metric results.
Implemented and owned the process to validate planner changes using behavior metrics. Using
pandas, implemented methods to find statistically significant improvements and regressions in metrics
easily. Collaborated with the data platform team to build frontend tools for developers to visualize
metrics, evaluate experiments based on metrics, and longitudinal tracking across time. Maintained a
roadmap and documentation for the API and gave support to users.
Implemented processes to increase the reliability of our pipelines, tracking errors, identifying owners,
and ensuring that issues get fixed. Wrote playbooks for on-call support. Lead team office hours to give
support to users.

positions.title: Data Engine Lead
positions.description:
Led a team of 4 engineers building internal tools and pipelines for the Deep Learning team and the DataQA team. 

IC work:
- Built and maintained DB with camera and lidar data used to train and evaluate deep learning models. Implemented python API to query
   - Technologies: Python, OpenCV, ros, sqlalchemy, docker, s3
- Built and maintained integration with 3rd party labeling service (ScaleAI) to enable the DataQA team to submit and review labeling tasks, as well as enabling the Deep Learning team to use labeled data
   - Technologies: http api, tornado
- Maintained and updated the data ingestion pipeline. 
   - Technologies: spark, airflow
- Built and maintained base docker image used by the Deep Learning team.
- Built video labeling tool in react
- Managed team design discussions, reviewed PRs, and provided technical feedback

Management:
- Managed a team of 4 engineers building and maintaining the data pipelines for ML work. The team built internal tools for the Deep Learning and DataQA teams, both as python APIs and react frontends.
- Managed team working on:
    - frontend to visualize data, stats about the data, metrics visualization and exploring
    - python rest API to serve the frontend
    - data ingestion pipeline
- Interfaced with the Deep Learning team, the DataQA team, the Infra team, PMs
- organized sprints, conducted 1:1s and performance evaluations

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managed a team of 6 engineers implementing the backend of a deep learning pipeline used by external clients and USG stakeholders.  Coordinated with Deep Learning researchers for the design and development of deep learning features.
Coordinated with Product, Frontend and Operations teams for the development of new platform features and delivering on one-off projects. Coordinated progress and longer-term project roadmapping with the leadership.
Managed the process of hiring and onboarding of new engineers to the team.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Built Deep Learning algorithms for detection of infrastructure in satellite and aerial imagery and drone video using Convolutional Neural Networks for commercial clients and the USG.
Designed, built and maintained a Deep Learning pipeline used internally to preprocess training data,  train models, evaluate and compare them, visualize outputs,  and deploy those  models  in the cloud.
Main technologies: Python, tensorflow, keras, numpy, flask, openCV, celery, docker

positions.title: Deep Learning Developer
positions.description:
Research and Development in the field of Deep Learning applied to Computer Vision.
Training of machine learning sistems based on Convolutional Neural Networks for doc-
ument analisys, classification and extraction of information.
Collaboration with Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC) for development and indus-
trialization of deep learning models
Development and maintenance of document analisys infrastructure implemented in python.
